product_metadata.title: YUKORE Pack of 2 Simpledecor Throw Pillow Covers Couch Pillow Shells,20X20 Inches,Jacquard Colorful Stripes,Multicolor Red
features: 2PCS brand new cushion covers/shells, no insert or filler.
The pillow cover size is 20X20 inches or 50X50 cm.
Fabric: Made of 100% grade A high quality jacquard fabric, both sides same design.
Invisible zipper design,all edges are sewn with zigzag overlock stitch to prevent fray.
Easy care-lightly spot clean or hand wash with mild detergent and cool water then air dry.
